signature: _extract_functions_brace(lines: list[str], lang_key: str, lang_cfg: dict) -> list[tuple[str, int, int]]
pre_condition: lines is a list of strings representing lines from a file whose language uses brace-delimited blocks. lang_key is a language key present in LANG_CONFIG. lang_cfg is a dictionary with 'skip_prefixes' (tuple of prefix strings), 'skip_keywords_line' (tuple of keywords), and 'body' set to 'brace'.
post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) tuples in source-line order, one per top-level function definition found in lines, where start_idx and end_idx are 0-based inclusive line indices spanning the full function body from the declaration line to the matching closing brace. name is the bare function identifier extracted from the declaration, excluding qualifiers, parameter lists, and return types. Lines that are comments (line or block), preprocessor directives, namespace/class/struct/enum declarations, variable declarations, or match any prefix or keyword exclusion from lang_cfg are not reported as function definitions. For Rust, a function definition is excluded when it is immediately preceded only by blank lines, line comments, attributes, and #[test]. Returns an empty list when no function definition is found.
